title: Which Trading Psychology Concepts Actually Work? (Tested With Claude)
summary: 83 scraped 'trading psychology' concepts turned into mechanical rules and run over 10,000 simulated trading years of a synthetic win/loss stream (37% win rate, $500 risk, ~2R winners, 750 trades/yr, $50k account). No market data, no instrument, no strategy. Verdicts: revenge trading 'true but for the wrong reason' (it is just bigger size); hesitation and profit targets cost money; stand-down-after-2-losses pays only if outcomes are autocorrelated; sizing up after hot streaks = zero; being picky ~zero, sizing up A+ setups = +$32k/yr; 1% risk per trade is the one unambiguous rule. Ends with four copy-paste Claude prompts to run the same math on your own broker CSV.
